    """Stand-in exposing only recv(), so no real socket is needed."""

        self.chunks = list(chunks)

        self.calls.append(cnt)
        if not self.chunks:
            return b''
        return self.chunks.pop(0)

    fake = FakeSocket(chunks)
    return sockssocket.recvall(fake, cnt), fake
